generation_settings.grammar:
args ::= object
args-kv ::= "\"args\"" space ":" space args
array ::= "[" space ( value ("," space value)* )? space "]"
boolean ::= ("true" | "false")
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
null ::= "null"
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
object ::= "{" space ( string ":" space value ("," space string ":" space value)* )? space "}"
root ::= "{" space tool-kv "," space args-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
tool ::= ("\"message\"" | "\"preserve\"" | "\"finish\"" | "\"fetch_local\"" | "\"fetch_peer\"" | "\"submit\"")
tool-kv ::= "\"tool\"" space ":" space tool
value ::= object | array | string | number | boolean | null
